scope: Connect github.com with a personal access token: validation with GET /user before an encrypted save, status-only projection, repository visibility check, disconnect, CREWROOM_GITHUB_TOKEN override, same-origin mutations. GitHub App device sign-in is deferred to FOR-51; GitHub Enterprise Server to FOR-50.

simulated.provider: Loopback GitHub API fixtures (axum in crates/crewroom-service/tests/github.rs; std TcpListener in crates/crewroom-desktop/src/workbench/credentials_tests.rs); not github.com.
checks: Fresh install reports disconnected; credentials.github.environment names CREWROOM_GITHUB_TOKEN
A token the fixture answers with 401 is refused (400) with GitHub's reason and credentials.json is not created
POST /api/credentials/github (unvalidated save) is refused; malformed connect bodies are refused
A valid classic token connects: account login, scopes and expiry shown; only a $crewroom$v1$ value is written (0600); no response or workspace contains the token
Repository check: fixture/visible reports granted with push; fixture/hidden reports 'No access to fixture/hidden (HTTP 404)'; a malformed name is refused
Token revoked at the fixture: the next check reports 'Expired or revoked' and keeps the saved token
Mutations with a foreign Origin, no Origin, or no bearer token are refused (403)

CREWROOM_GITHUB_TOKEN set: source environment, state unchecked until checked, then connected as a fine-grained token with the permissions note; Disconnect removes the saved token while the override stays active
Restart: a saved token is shown as not checked since the service started, then connected after Check connection
Install key removed: state unreadable, check sends no request, plain connect refused (409), replaceUnreadable reconnects; /credentials/github/clear disconnects
Unreachable GitHub: connect refused (409, 'could not be validated'), nothing saved; an override check reports 'Connection not confirmed', not revoked
Desktop Settings → Integrations → GitHub: rejected token shows the reason and clears the field; valid token shows account and kind without rendering the token; repository no-access line; Disconnect

live.endpoint: https://api.github.com through a debug crewroomd built from the implementation revision 07f2086 (sha256 1ffa1430874de0577974a4f3d440e36d30ef86f3b87bbe147b3a217b153b6cbd); an identical receipt was first observed on the pre-rebase revision 772cc5a (base d08fc59, binary sha256 95ce0d24fc96e429f332efd2670609656fcf2bf0c1625c57e99817742d3eaffc), loopback port 4347, isolated temporary --data-dir (deleted afterwards)
live.credential: The operator's gh CLI login token, read in-process and never printed. It is a gh OAuth token (reported kind 'other'), not a fine-grained or classic personal access token.
live.redaction: Account login replaced with <login>; no token, scopes list or account id retained.

cases.case: invalid synthetic token rejected by github.com
cases.error: Token not saved. GitHub rejected the token (HTTP 401): it is invalid, expired or revoked. GitHub said: "Bad credentials".

cases.label: This token can see <login>/crewroom (your account can push).
No access to crewroom-synthetic-owner-0/does-not-exist (HTTP 404). The repository does not exist or this token cannot see it; for a fine-grained token, add it under Repository access.

commands.cargo test --locked -p crewroom-runtime: pass on 2e8a500 (desktop 135 passed / 15 ignored; runtime lib 56 passed / 1 ignored plus integration suites; service lib 4 plus integration suites including github 2/2 and credentials 1/1)
commands.cargo clippy --locked -p crewroom-deskto: clean (with --all-targets, the pre-existing useless_conversion in untouched feedback_tests.rs remains)

limitations: Live github.com validation used a gh OAuth token; no fine-grained or classic personal access token was exercised live, and the live revoked/expired transition was exercised only as a 401 for an invalid token.

A repository check confirms visibility and the account's role permissions; GitHub does not report a fine-grained token's permission grant, so issue/PR/contents writes are confirmed only when FOR-45/FOR-46 use them.
Check results are in memory only; after a restart Settings shows 'not checked' until Check connection.
npm run test:e2e was not run (the integrator runs it serially).
